title: Measuring a Year's Use From a Window That Is Not a Year, Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts
content:
Where the window the prior use of an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts is counted over is not twelve months long, the gallons taken over it are put onto a yearly footing before they are used, and how they are put onto it depends on which way the window runs and on how busy the account has been.

**Where the window the prior use is counted over is shorter than twelve months and three or more stops were made on the account in the twelve months ending on the handling date**, the prior use is the gallons taken over that window grossed up to a full year by twelve over the months of the window, rounded to one decimal place.

**Where the window is longer than twelve months and three or more stops were made in that window**, the prior use is the gallons taken over that window halved, rounded to one decimal place.

**In every other case** the prior use is the gallons taken over that window as they stand.

## The three measures

| The window | Stops in the twelve months ending on the handling date | The prior use |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Shorter than twelve months | Three or more | The gallons over the window, multiplied by twelve and divided by the months of the window, to one decimal place |
| Longer than twelve months | Three or more | The gallons over the window, halved, to one decimal place |
| Exactly twelve months, or fewer than three stops | Either way | The gallons over the window as they stand |

*Hypothetical, a short window.* An account whose prior use is counted over a six-month window took 700.0 gallons in it, with four stops in the year. Twelve over six is two, so the prior use is 1400.0 gallons.

*Hypothetical, a long window.* An account whose prior use is counted over a twenty-four-month window took 3100.0 gallons in it, with four stops in the year. Halved, the prior use is 1550.0 gallons.

*Hypothetical, a plain year.* An account whose prior use is counted over twelve months took 1800.0 gallons in it. The prior use is 1800.0 gallons as they stand.
